purpose: Chrome-less public report for an owner-selected drive, with the same route dispatching charging-session payloads to SharedSessionReport.
primaryGoal: Read only owner-disclosed measurements and redacted route/profile information without an account; understand unavailable links and omitted measurements.

dataSources.name: Public share payload
dataSources.behavior: Token-scoped shared-drive query key, enabled only for a nonempty parameter, retry=false, STALE_TIMES.SLOW, AbortSignal forwarded. Page branches charging_session before drive normalization. Error takes precedence over cached session/drive rendering.
dataSources.ownership: Server owns lookup, expiry, revocation lookup outcome, disclosure flags, model/color projection, coordinate clipping and view counting. Public route registration precedes the main API group and documents an external ForwardAuth exemption. Deployment enforcement is unverified.
dataSources.privacy: Only endpoint templates are recorded; no real token, address, coordinate or payload was accessed. A GET increments views; consequently no runtime public request was made.

dataSources.name: Canonical and transitional public payload adapter
dataSources.behavior: Canonical payloads are returned by reference based on presence of payload_version, including SI payloads tagged v1. Untagged legacy payloads upgrade distance/duration/speed/efficiency once; nullable scalars remain null and absent legacy profile arrays become empty arrays. Session discrimination uses share_type. Preserve this existing explicit share-link transition rather than introducing another adapter.
dataSources.units: Drive measurements: m, s, m/s, Wh/m; elevation fields are meters. Profile converters execute at display boundary. Telemetry power/elevation type names alone do not establish units, and the root page does not render telemetry.

dataSources.name: Viewer formatting preferences
dataSources.behavior: Public brief uses the explicit preference bridge; however root useUnits still invokes settings query and cross-tab settings subscription. NumberFormatting observes the existing formatter preference bridge. Defaults support unavailable settings. Anonymous failure/redirect behavior is not exercised.

dataSources.name: Conditional map configuration and external tiles
dataSources.behavior: Only mounted when more than one disclosed coordinate exists. map-config query selects configured provider or fallback OSM; low-bandwidth policy retains provider while choosing lighter tiles. No provider configuration or credentials were accessed. Tile/network privacy and anonymous configuration availability require integration review.

dataSources.name: Charging-session dispatch dependency
dataSources.behavior: Same checked public payload, no additional session fetch. Preserve owner-selected summary and gated curve/cost. Session curve source exposes power_kw and energy_kwh despite v2 summary SI fields; this existing mixed-unit contract must not be silently converted twice or renamed during presentation work. Full curve derivation was not audited.

components.contract: Existing category barrels; retain standalone w-full/min-w-0 layout, localized public branding, source title/date/description, optional addresses and vehicle model/color. Do not mount authenticated workspace selectors or shell merely to obtain shared layout.

Raw source metrics plus specialist display callbacks, explicit units/currency preferences, event date, source provenance and raw evidence. Unknown is not zero; no scored confidence or inferred cause. Brief says date is event context, not freshness. Retain conditional metric inclusion and evidence access.

Existing host/card and canonical export toolbar; preserve localized accessible names, both distance-indexed series, converted axis/tooltip values and image/vector export affordances. data/dataColumns are available for accessible rows and CSV but not supplied by root.

Render only returned clipped coordinates; scrollWheelZoom=false, current zoom/center and endpoint markers. FadeIn honors reduced-motion hook with initial=false and ignores delays when reduced. No runtime map/focus/motion acceptance inferred.

Loading status and geometry, safe unavailable view with home navigation, aggregate route-empty explanation and session dispatch remain. Root has one exported component; two private state helpers are not an exported-component violation.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Public drive and session presentations repeat branded standalone header, optional vehicle card, chart tooltip chrome and footer. PublicReportBrief already consolidates measurement provenance; do not duplicate it.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing primitives; assess a presentation-only public report frame for two confirmed consumers, preserving different hero/summary geometry and owner-redacted optional slots.

observed: Root/sections use full width, min-w-0 and px-4; chart viewports are responsive width with fixed 200px heights.
Hero uses 50vh; loading reserves hero even if owner omitted route. Loading has two-column metrics rising to three at md; loaded state is the shared brief, not that skeleton grid.

issues.detail: Fixed half-viewport hero and zoom=7 lack route fit/bounds logic at this call site; long/short disclosed traces can be poorly framed. Long header/address text, chart toolbar and metric evidence mobile behavior are unverified.
issues.fix: Validate 320-2560 widths and long localized source text; use existing map bounds capabilities if needed without requesting unredacted coordinates or changing disclosed data.

responsive.viewportTesting: Unverified; no browser or device used.

observed: Loading exposes role=status, aria-busy and localized name; expired-state icon is decorative.
Charts have localized ariaLabel; links retain native semantics and external link uses noopener noreferrer.
Shared FadeIn has source-confirmed reduced-motion support.

issues.detail: Start/end map markers differ by red/green only at this call site; neither marker has a textual label or popup. This expresses endpoints of the clipped visible trace, not exact private trip endpoints.
issues.fix: Add localized visible/accessible start and end labels using existing map presentation; describe them explicitly as disclosed trace endpoints.

issues.detail: Both charts explicitly exempt dense traces from accessible tables; wrapper names do not expose per-sample values, and root does not pass data/dataColumns to the existing ChartCard contract.
issues.fix: Evaluate an accessible disclosed-samples table or appropriate equivalent through existing chart owner; use only returned profile values and maintain existing exports and privacy.

issues.detail: Ready/loading/unavailable roots use div rather than a main landmark. Source has no usePageTitle in root. App provides RouteAnnouncer/RouteFocusManager, but title updates and actual h1 focus on this standalone report are not established.
issues.fix: Preserve chrome-less public layout while providing a main landmark and safe localized document title; verify shared PageHeader heading/focus integration and links at 44px target defaults.

accessibility.runtime: Keyboard, screen reader, focus, effective contrast, touch targets, forced colors, RTL, 200% text and reduced-motion rendering unverified.

states.loading: SharedDriveLoading with named busy status, header, hero placeholder, six metric placeholders and two chart placeholders; conditional disclosed content may differ.
states.ready: Drive normalization then public brief; optional vehicle/map/profiles. charging_session dispatch before drive-empty handling.
states.empty: No data renders unavailable link; no route/profiles renders one explanatory EmptyState. Individual missing map/elevation/speed sections disappear; omission is owner/privacy/source-dependent, not permission to fetch private substitutes.
states.error: Any query error renders expired/revoked explanation and home link, even when usable cached data exists. Cached payload cannot bypass failed token check.
states.staleOffline: Root reads only data/isLoading/error, not freshness/fetchStatus/isPaused/dataUpdatedAt. Brief correctly says event date is not freshness. No explicit paused/offline/refresh-recovery presentation.

issues.detail: Transport failure, server failure and invalid/expired/revoked token all produce the same expiry explanation without retry. Current fail-closed ordering protects cached public payload after a failed token check; ordinary retained-data guidance cannot blindly override it.
issues.fix: Integration-owner design must distinguish confirmed unavailable-token responses from connectivity/paused states and offer safe recovery, while preserving failed-token suppression and public-cache policy. Do not show stale private content merely to improve visual continuity.

visualIssues.detail: Speed uses fixed electric cyan #00f0ff, outside existing theme/palette preference; tooltip chrome is duplicated fixed black rgba at lines 320 and 358. Elevation uses a themed gradient. No glow classes were found in root.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing restrained palette and shared ChartTooltip styling; preserve deliberate saved palette choices and data prominence rather than inventing another color engine.

visualIssues.detail: Footer link uses theme-primary/60 and unavailable-state icon background uses fixed white opacity. Effective contrast across custom/light themes is unknown; class names alone cannot establish a contrast failure.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer canonical text/surface tokens and measure composed backgrounds and hover/focus states in centralized visual QA.

architectureIssues.detail: useUnits calls useSettings, whose unconditionally enabled query refetches settings on mount and subscribes to settings broadcasts. Thus a chrome-less public route still depends on an authenticated settings mechanism; conditional MapTileLayer adds map-config query. The public metric bridge itself avoids such queries.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should provide an explicit public-safe preference/config contract preserving current unit/locale/default behavior, without widening authentication or disclosing operator credentials. Page consumes it; shared hooks/config are outside a page worker's ownership.

architectureIssues.detail: Brief calls efficiency a recorded intensity, but inspected handler calculates an approximate value from battery delta and a fixed factor when distance exceeds 2000m. Frontend cannot establish measured energy or pack capacity from this payload.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve existing calculation and value; adjust source-specific explanation with integration/backend owner to identify approximation and limitations rather than claiming new measured evidence.

architectureIssues.detail: exportable enables shared image/vector controls but root supplies no exportData/data/dataColumns. CSV or raw-SI export capability is not established for these charts; do not describe exportable as proof of all formats.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve current image/vector affordances; if adding table/CSV support, supply only owner-disclosed points with explicit SI field and display-unit contracts through existing chart API.

priority.rationale: Public disclosure and expiry correctness constrain modernization; resolve public preference/auth coupling and error semantics before cosmetic adoption. Follow with equivalent accessible samples/endpoints and restrained chart presentation.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Public-safe preference and map configuration boundary
propsVariantsStates: Explicit existing UnitPref/locale/precision inputs and documented anonymous defaults
No authenticated workspace/settings subscription required by public presentation
Map provider fallback and low-bandwidth behavior; no credentials in audit/telemetry
requiredSharedChanges.necessity: Confirmed integration gap; do not change shared interfaces from page scope.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Public share trust/recovery presentation policy
propsVariantsStates: Failed token check suppresses cached drive AND session
dependsOn: Query cache and HTTP public max-age policy
requiredSharedChanges.necessity: Policy coordination, not a new generic state engine.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Reuse public frame and chart accessibility contracts
requiredSharedChanges.owner: Existing PageHeader/LayoutCard/ChartCard/ChartContainer; public frame missing as a dedicated owner
propsVariantsStates: Localized branded header and optional source metadata
Optional disclosed hero/vehicle slots and footer
Omitted source remains omitted; never private-source recovery
requiredSharedChanges.necessity: Reuse/possible extension after two-consumer preservation review; no speculative replacement library.

competingImplementations.detail: Feature tooltip styling repeats shared chart chrome and session chart implementation. Existing public metric summary is already consolidated. Root correctly imports chart/map/motion category barrels rather than direct vendor libraries.
competingImplementations.fix: Reuse canonical chart tooltip presentation without altering specialist SI-to-display callbacks or public disclosure.

preservation.sourceHashScope: Exact root page bytes only; not dependency/runtime/cryptographic share verification.
actions: Learn-more external navigation with noopener noreferrer
Existing shared chart image/vector export toolbar
Public brief evidence/details through existing OperationalBrief contract, runtime unverified
dataBehavior: Keep public /s/:token lazy route outside Layout, SafeRoute wrapper and existing guards; no second workspace selectors.
Preserve nonempty-token enablement, query key, retry=false, stale policy and AbortSignal; never expose raw token in audit/log/storage changes.

Server lookup and expiry remain authoritative; current error precedence suppresses cached drive/session. HTTP public max-age=300 and view increment are existing behavior requiring explicit policy review, not a UI correctness guarantee.

Never reconstruct deleted/redacted coordinates or source identifiers. Handler exposes model/color rather than VIN/IDs and clips three positions from both ends for traces longer than six; source clipping is not proof of anonymization.
Addresses are included in inspected drive summary projection; include_map controls map points, not blanket address redaction. Do not imply stronger privacy than source establishes.
Speed summaries/profiles respect IncludeSpeed; map points respect IncludeMap. Elevation profiles are produced inside the shared positions loop; do not invent an independent elevation permission.
Preserve canonical-by-discriminator behavior and exact explicit legacy share-link SI upgrade; never convert canonical v1-tagged SI twice.
Drive display conversions: m to km/mi; m/s to km/h/mph; elevation m to ft only for miles preference; Wh/m to Wh/km then optional Wh/mi. Keep nullable measurements distinct from zero.

Preserve distance/duration, optional efficiency, battery endpoints, max/average speed and elevation gain with raw source evidence. Elevation loss and telemetry exist in types but are not root-rendered sections; do not invent them as current functionality.
Preserve session branch summary, curve/cost disclosure and existing mixed curve wire units; no fake measurements, scored confidence or cryptographic attestation.
Map/profile/vehicle optional gates are disclosure-sensitive. Missing-data modernization must not reveal what the owner omitted.

evidenceLimits.mode: Read-only source audit with two authorized documentation/status outputs.
evidenceLimits.runtime: UNVERIFIED: no application, browser, network request, real sharing, token creation/revocation, download or production mutation exercised.
evidenceLimits.security: Source behavior descriptions only; no vulnerability review or proof of token entropy, cryptographic signature, deployment authentication exemption, anonymization or revocation propagation. SHA-256 is a preservation checksum only.
evidenceLimits.validation: No Git, TypeScript, full-repository lint/build, skill audit script or nested agent used. Skill script was read but not run because it unconditionally performs project-wide TypeScript. Targeted source patterns were inspected instead.

commandEvidence.output: rg: The term 'rg' is not recognized. Replaced with supplied functions.rg for scoped source inspection.

unknowns: Effective theme contrast and map control targets
Public settings/config network fallback and session-refresh behavior
Exact export runtime and all shared brief interactions
Long text, RTL, zoom and mobile chart labels
Session signal curve unit derivation; pattern-only review is not a full backend audit
evidenceLimits.snapshot: Line citations describe inspected concurrent-source snapshot, not a frozen whole-application baseline.
